name: surjOn_of_injOn_of_card_le
statement: α → β) (hf : Set.MapsTo f s t) (hinj : Set.InjOn f s) (hst : #t ≤ #s) : Set.SurjOn f s t

name: surj_on_of_inj_on_of_card_le
statement: ∀ a ∈ s, β) (hf : ∀ a ha, f a ha ∈ t) (hinj : ∀ a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂, f a₁ ha₁ = f a₂ ha₂ → a₁ = a₂) (hst : #t ≤ #s) : ∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a ha, b = f a ha

have_tree.name: hinj'
have_tree.body: fun x hx y hy hxy ↦ Subtype.ext (hinj _ _ x.2 y.2 hxy)

name: injOn_of_surjOn_of_card_le
statement: α → β) (hf : Set.MapsTo f s t) (hsurj : Set.SurjOn f s t) (hst : #s ≤ #t) : Set.InjOn f s

name: inj_on_of_surj_on_of_card_le
statement: ∀ a ∈ s, β) (hf : ∀ a ha, f a ha ∈ t) (hsurj : ∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a ha, f a ha = b) (hst : #s ≤ #t) ⦃a₁⦄ (ha₁ : a₁ ∈ s) ⦃a₂⦄ (ha₂ : a₂ ∈ s) (ha₁a₂ : f a₁ ha₁ = f a₂ ha₂) : a₁ = a₂

have_tree.name: hsurj'
have_tree.body: fun x hx ↦ by simpa [f'] using hsurj x hx

have_tree.name: hinj'
have_tree.body: injOn_of_surjOn_of_card_le f' (fun x hx ↦ hf _ _) hsurj' (by simpa)

name: exists_eq_insert_iff
statement: Finset α} : (∃ a ∉ s, insert a s = t) ↔ s ⊆ t ∧ #s + 1 = #t
